description: This file contains integration tests for the DELETE endpoint of catalog items, specifically for deleting a catalog item by ID, including cases for valid and invalid IDs with admin authorization.

classes.name: DeleteCatalogItemEndpointTest
classes.description: Test class for the DELETE catalog item endpoint, containing methods to verify successful deletion and handling of non-existent IDs.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessGivenValidIdAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Tests that deleting a catalog item with a valid ID and admin token returns a success status.

methods.name: ReturnsNotFoundGivenInvalidIdAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Tests that attempting to delete a catalog item with an invalid ID returns a 404 Not Found status.
